landmarks.name: Zion National Park
landmarks.fact: A prominent national park in southwestern Utah known for its steep sandstone cliffs and scenic canyons.

landmarks.name: Pa'rus Trailhead
landmarks.fact: The starting point for a paved multi-use trail following the Virgin River in Zion National Park.

landmarks.name: First Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: One of several pedestrian bridges along the Pa'rus Trail crossing the scenic Virgin River in Zion National Park.

landmarks.name: Second Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: A footbridge providing views of surrounding red sandstone cliffs and lush riparian vegetation in Zion National Park.

landmarks.name: Third Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: A scenic pedestrian bridge spanning the Virgin River along the paved Pa'rus Trail.

landmarks.name: The Watchman
landmarks.fact: A famous 6,578-foot sandstone peak towering above the southern entrance of Zion National Park.

landmarks.name: Fourth Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: A footbridge offering panoramic views of Zion Canyon's towering red rock walls and riverbed.

landmarks.name: Fifth Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: A steel pedestrian bridge linking trail sections along the river corridor in Zion National Park.

landmarks.name: South Campground Bridge
landmarks.fact: A bridge located near Zion's South Campground, connecting trail sections across the main park road.

landmarks.name: Sixth Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: A footbridge offering cyclists and hikers a safe crossing over the Virgin River with mountain backdrops.

landmarks.name: Seventh Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: A pedestrian bridge providing scenic views of the Virgin River and surrounding rock formations.

landmarks.name: Eighth Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: A footbridge located near the Canyon Junction area of Zion National Park.

landmarks.name: Ninth Virgin River Bridge
landmarks.fact: A scenic footbridge near Canyon Junction where the Pa'rus Trail meets the Zion Canyon Scenic Drive.

landmarks.name: Canyon Junction Shuttle Stop
landmarks.fact: Shuttle Stop 3 in Zion National Park, where visitors board park shuttles up Zion Canyon Scenic Drive.
